segments.ja305:1.1: Natthi loke raho nāma, pāpakammaṃ pakubbato;
segments.ja305:1.3: Passanti vanabhūtāni, taṃ bālo maññatī raho.
segments.ja305:2.1: Ahaṃ raho na passāmi, suññaṃ vāpi na vijjati;
segments.ja305:2.3: Yattha aññaṃ [suññaṃ (syā. ka.)] na passāmi, asuññaṃ hoti taṃ mayā.
segments.ja305:3.1: Dujjacco ca sujacco [ajacco (pī.)] ca, nando ca sukhavaḍḍhito [sukhavacchako (sī.), sukhavacchano (syā. pī.)];
segments.ja305:3.3: Vejjo ca addhuvasīlo [atha sīlo (ka.)] ca, te dhammaṃ jahu matthikā.
segments.ja305:4.1: Brāhmaṇo ca kathaṃ jahe, sabbadhammāna pāragū;
